description: Spec 024: spec 023's engagements (seed 348, same base stream, so the same first target and bearing noise) with realism drawn from a stream of its own: the ownship steers on measured bearings and a range belief with 30% (log) error, closing on where it last believed the target to be when it has no contact; contact gaps of 10-60 min at 0.15 an hour; detection falling off around 40 km (half at 40 km, 4 km wide); a second target, with bearings swapped half the time where the two contacts are within 1 degree. An investigation, never a gate result.
